stepLabels.prep-equipment: Inspect and stage the equipment needed for this batch.
stepLabels.prep-ingredients: Measure and stage fermentables, hops, yeast, and any other planned ingredients.
stepLabels.prep-water: Prepare brewing water and any treatment appropriate to your source water.
stepLabels.prep-sparge: Prepare additional water for sparging or volume adjustments, if needed.
stepLabels.mash-dough: Combine the grain and water according to your recipe; stir out dry pockets.
stepLabels.mash-settle: Set up the grain bed and any recirculation appropriate to your equipment.
stepLabels.mash-rest2: Complete an additional mash rest, if planned.
stepLabels.lauter-lift: Separate the wort from the grain using your brewing setup.
stepLabels.lauter-sparge: Sparge if needed, stopping at the planned pre-boil volume.
stepLabels.lauter-sample: Mix the wort thoroughly and take a representative gravity sample.
stepLabels.lauter-record: Record pre-boil volume and gravity; note sample temperature or correction.
stepLabels.boil-start: Establish a steady boil and start the planned boil timer.
stepLabels.boil-hop60: Make the first planned hop addition at its scheduled time.
stepLabels.boil-hop20: Make later hop additions and prepare the chilling equipment, as applicable.
stepLabels.boil-fining10: Add any planned finings, nutrients, or other kettle additions at their scheduled times.
stepLabels.boil-flameout: Turn off the heat and make any planned flameout additions.
stepLabels.boil-steep: Complete any planned steep or whirlpool hold before chilling.
stepLabels.transfer-sanitize: Confirm the fermenter, transfer tubing, and sampling equipment are sanitized.
stepLabels.transfer-chill: Chill the wort to the planned pitch temperature.
stepLabels.transfer-transfer: Transfer to the fermenter and record the volume.
stepLabels.transfer-og: Measure and record original gravity, with sample correction if needed.
stepLabels.transfer-pitch: Confirm pitch temperature and add yeast according to the chosen yeast instructions.
stepLabels.transfer-control: Seal the fermenter and set up the planned fermentation conditions.
stepLabels.transfer-cleanup: Clean equipment and record anything worth changing next time.
